title: PDH, PDL and equilibrium on a real day
frame: ES futures, 1-hour bars, 00:00 to 16:00 ET, Thu 11 Dec 2025

steps.title: Yesterday's three lines
steps.caption: Wed 10 Dec 2025. The previous session's high was 6,908.00, its low 6,830.75, and the midpoint, equilibrium, 6,869.38. Marked before the day opened.

steps.title: The run on the PDL
steps.caption: At 00:00 price traded through the previous day's low to 6,829.50 and by 00:00 had closed back above it. The stops under yesterday's low were the first draw of the day.

steps.title: Discount to premium
steps.caption: Price crossed equilibrium at 07:00 and was in premium from there: the half of yesterday's range where you look to sell, not to buy.

steps.title: The PDH
steps.caption: The previous day's high at 6,908.00 was reached at 14:00. Low run in the morning, high reached in the afternoon: the three lines told you where the orders were, and the day went to both.
